text: Copilot in Fabric isn't a separate chat window — it's an AI experience built directly into the Fabric item you're already working in: a notebook, a KQL queryset, a report, a pipeline.
Inside a notebook, Copilot shows up two ways: the chat pane for multi-step workflows across cells with a reviewable diff, and in-cell Copilot's slash commands scoped to a single cell.
Copilot is schema-aware — it understands your attached lakehouse's actual tables, files, and telemetry, so plain questions get answers grounded in your real workspace, not a generic guess.
When a cell fails, Fix with Copilot gives an error summary, a root-cause guess, and a suggested fix you review as a diff. By default it always asks before running or applying anything.
Chat pane for multi-step workflows, in-cell slash commands for a quick fix — both schema-aware, both reviewable. Next up: using Copilot's chat pane to generate an actual notebook.
